status_error_alert: Error detected in last verification. Check the logs for details.
status_empty_desc: Add an anime from the Add anime screen, or configure an AniList or MyAnimeList account and run a check.
status_filter_account_removed: The user filter pointed at an account that is no longer configured, so it was removed.
status_filter_account_failed: Couldn't load the list of {accounts}, so this filter is missing its animes. It retries on the next refresh.
config_missing_banner: There are missing configurations — please fill them in to continue.
config_hint_anilist_usernames: Anilist accounts to track. Optional — you can also add animes one by one from the Add anime screen.
config_hint_mal_usernames: MyAnimeList accounts to track. The list must be public. Excluded lists don't apply — MyAnimeList has no custom lists.
config_hint_download_statuses: List statuses (AniList and MyAnimeList) to download anime from
config_hint_download_media_statuses: Anime airing statuses eligible for download
config_hint_delete_statuses: List statuses (AniList and MyAnimeList) that trigger deletion of downloaded episodes
config_hint_completed_path: Your Jellyfin library. Completed episodes are hardlinked here, and in-progress downloads live in a hidden .torrents folder inside it.
config_hint_completed_path_direct: Your Jellyfin library. Each torrent is written straight into it, under one folder per series, and seeds from there.
config_library_is_folder: Your library is the download folder {name} ({path}) in the list below: its path is set there, and changing it moves the library.
config_hint_completed_path_unlisted: Not one of your download folders, so new torrents don't go here. Downloads from before the folders were set still live here.
config_hint_watched_keep: Set to 0 to delete all watched episodes
config_hint_max_concurrent: Torrents beyond this limit wait in the queue. Set to 0 for no limit; seeding is never limited.
config_hint_check_for_updates: Asks GitHub once a day whether a newer version was released, to show it next to the version and send the update notification. Turn it off if your package manager already tells you (AUR, Docker).
config_hint_disable_seeding: Never uploads to other peers, not even while downloading, and removes each torrent and its download copy once the episode is in the library. Downloads may be slower: peers favor those who upload back. Parts of a pack that were not linked into the library (another season, extras) are deleted with it. With direct library mode the files stay where they are: they are the library.
config_hint_max_concurrent_qbittorrent_m: With qBittorrent, the app sets qBittorrent's own download queue to this.
config_hint_max_concurrent_qbittorrent_o: With qBittorrent this doesn't apply: qBittorrent's own download queue does, unless you let the app manage its settings in Torrent client.
config_hint_disable_seeding_qbittorrent: With qBittorrent it means almost no upload: qBittorrent can't refuse uploads altogether, so each torrent is held to the limit below until its episode is in the library, and is then removed.
config_hint_qbittorrent_disable_seeding_: Per torrent, while it downloads. The download's own requests to peers also go through it, so a download runs at most a few hundred times this: 16 KiB/s allows roughly 5 to 16 MB/s. Lower uploads less and downloads slower.
config_label_rename_jellyfin: Rename files to a standard format (useful for Plex/Jellyfin)
config_hint_rename_jellyfin: Renames episode files to "Anime Name - E05.mkv", including the ones inside batch packs, for better metadata matching
config_label_direct_mode: Write Downloads Straight to the Library
config_hint_direct_mode: No hardlinks and no separate download folder: each torrent is written once, as <Series>/Season 01/ for episodes, Specials/ for movies and its own folders for packs, and seeds from there. Works on drives without hardlink support. Only affects torrents added after you turn it on. With the Jellyfin AniList plugin, every season in a series folder shows the first season's metadata.
config_hint_auto_delete_downloads: For torrents added in direct mode, even after you switch back. Off keeps them forever and keeps seeding them: watched or dropped episodes are never deleted, and while direct mode is on the per-anime episode limit is ignored. On applies the usual deletion settings, and deleting a file also stops seeding it.
config_hint_keep_removed_release_cards: The anime page lists the torrents that brought its episodes. On, a torrent that is gone (watched and deleted, removed by hand) keeps its card, marked removed. Off, its card goes with it.
config_hint_part_files: Write a file as "name.part" while it downloads and give it its real name when the torrent finishes, so the media server never picks up a half-downloaded episode.
config_hint_season_numbering: With episode renaming on: when a season comes as two AniList entries (Part 1 and Part 2), Part 2's first episode becomes S02E13, the way TVDB and TMDB number it. Off keeps AniList's numbers and adds a part tag, like "S02E01 (Part 2)".
config_hint_excluded_list: AniList custom lists that should not be downloaded
config_val_interval: Check interval must be greater than 0
config_hint_recent_shelf_days: How many days a finished download stays on the Status page's Recently downloaded shelf while you haven't watched it. 0 turns the shelf off.
config_val_recent_shelf_days: The Recently downloaded shelf takes 0 (off) to 30 days
config_hint_max_episodes: How many episodes of one anime exist at the same time. Applies to the episode-by-episode path only — a pack is a single torrent, so limiting records would not limit bytes. Set to 0 for no limit (a pack search then covers every pending episode at once).
config_val_max_episodes: Max episodes per anime must be non-negative
config_val_retry: Episode retry limit must be at least 1
config_val_max_concurrent: Max concurrent downloads must be non-negative
config_val_qbittorrent_disable_seeding_u: The upload limit with qBittorrent must be at least 1 KiB/s
config_val_watched_keep: Watched episodes to keep must be non-negative
logs_empty_filtered: No logs match the current filters.
detail_empty: No episodes found for this anime.
detail_confirm_msg: Episode {number} is deleted with its file, and it won't be downloaded again. Back to automatic undoes that.

match.count=1: {count} episode is deleted with its file and won't be downloaded again. Back to automatic undoes that.
match.count=*: {count} episodes are deleted with their files and won't be downloaded again. Back to automatic undoes that.

match.count=1: {count} episode will be deleted and searched again on Nyaa.
match.count=*: {count} episodes will be deleted and searched again on Nyaa.

detail_replace_invalid_magnet: Please enter a valid magnet link
detail_redownload_confirm_msg: Episode {number} will be deleted and searched again on Nyaa.
notifications_subtitle: Configure webhook integrations for download notifications
notifications_preview_title: What this webhook sends (sample values, nothing is sent)
notifications_hint_sources: Only notify about animes on the checked accounts' lists (any list status) or tracked as standalone. Nothing checked = every anime. The Test button ignores this filter.
notifications_event_check_failing: Checks are failing (and back to normal)
notifications_event_season_complete: Finished anime fully in the library
notifications_event_leftover_files: Weekly digest of watched files still on disk
notifications_hint_batch_window: Groups the events of the same window into a single webhook. Use 0 to disable and send one per event. Useful with rate-limited services (e.g. ntfy.sh) — a library backfill can fire dozens of notifications at once.
downloads_empty_desc: Torrents appear here while they download, and stay while they seed.
downloads_files_missing_detail: File not found. It won't be downloaded again on its own; use "Redownload missing files" or delete the episode here.
downloads_redownload_missing_hint: Untick any torrent you want to leave as it is. The ticked ones download their missing files again, into the same place.

match.count=1: {count} torrent skipped: not enough disk space
match.count=*: {count} torrents skipped: not enough disk space

downloads_bulk_none: No selected torrent needed this action
downloads_empty_filtered_desc: Try a different search term or clear the status filter.
downloads_delete_consequence_blocked: This episode will not be downloaded again.
downloads_delete_consequence_blocked_ani: This anime's episodes will not be downloaded again.
downloads_delete_consequence_untracked: The anime leaves the standalone list and will not be downloaded again.
downloads_delete_consequence_will_redown: Warning: without this option, the daemon may download this episode again on its next pass, since the record will still exist without a matching torrent.
detail_progress_hint: Manual progress for a standalone anime. Raising it deletes what is behind it (keeping "Watched Episodes to Keep" outside a pack, and the whole pack inside one), unless direct mode keeps downloads forever (Delete Downloads Automatically off). With "Delete watched episodes automatically" off nothing is deleted and no new pack is fetched.
detail_shoko_offset: This anime's episode 1 is the series' episode {n}.
detail_shoko_partial: The Shoko series {series} shares this anime's MAL id, but the episodes don't line up: check it by hand. Until then, nothing counts as in Shoko.
detail_shoko_saved: Saved. The next check pass applies it.
detail_shoko_unavailable: Shoko can't reach its file right now
detail_shoko_packs_label: Episodes in Shoko that a pack brings
detail_shoko_packs_hint: A pack downloads whole. Download them: the app keeps them as its own. Remove them: with qBittorrent they're never downloaded; otherwise they're deleted once the pack finishes, and the pack stops seeding.
detail_releases_load_error: Could not load this anime's torrents.
detail_releases_origin_unknown: Added before release details were kept
downloads_ws_banner: No connection to the daemon — the progress below may be out of date
config_hint_max_batch_size: Pack torrents above this size are discarded from the search results. This is the only ceiling on packs: ~40 GiB fits a 26-episode 1080p pack, and the 100 GiB default deliberately does not fit a full One Piece pack (a partial pack does). Set to 0 for no limit.
config_hint_max_episode_size: Single-episode torrents above this size are discarded from the search results (~1.5 GiB for a 1080p episode). Set to 0 for no limit.
config_hint_max_search_pages: Ceiling on Nyaa result pages per search. A search only goes to the next page while it has few accepted candidates, so this is a limit and not a fixed cost — most searches still read a single page.
config_hint_nyaa_request_delay: Seconds to wait between two Nyaa page requests (search and torrent detail pages), across every anime searched at once. Raise it if Nyaa answers with errors or Cloudflare checks; a check then takes longer. Set to 0 for no wait.
config_hint_min_seeders: Torrents with fewer seeders than this are discarded from the search results. The default of 3 blocks dead torrents (which otherwise get picked when they are the only candidate) and the ones with a single seeder, which stall often. Set to 0 for no floor.
config_hint_min_free_disk: GiB of slack kept on the library volume after queued downloads. New torrents are refused below this. Set to 0 to disable the policy.
config_val_torrent_size: Torrent size limits must be non-negative
config_val_max_search_pages: Max search pages must be non-negative
config_val_nyaa_request_delay: The wait between Nyaa requests must be non-negative
config_val_min_free_disk: Min free disk space must be non-negative
config_val_incomplete_min_free_disk: Min free space for the incomplete folder must be non-negative
config_hint_download_roots: New torrents go to the first folder in the list with room: each folder fills until its drive would keep less than its Keep Free, then the next one takes over. Move a folder up to make it the highest priority; the order only decides where new torrents go, and what is already downloaded stays in its folder. An anime can pick its own folder on its page, and a new season goes next to the earlier ones. An empty Keep Free uses Min Free Disk Space. Empty list = the Completed Anime Path alone; each folder must already exist.
config_val_download_roots: Every download folder needs a name and a folder, and names can't repeat
detail_root_hint: New torrents of this anime go to this folder first; when it's full they go to the next.
detail_root_saved: Saved. New torrents of this anime go there.
config_hint_incomplete_path: Optional. Torrents download here and move into the library when they finish, so the library disk only takes one sequential write per file. Use an SSD or NVMe folder, especially when the library is on a USB or SMR hard disk. The folder must already exist, inside that drive (not its mount point itself) and outside the library. Files here keep their real names.
config_label_incomplete_min_free_disk: Min Free Space for Incomplete Folder
config_hint_incomplete_min_free_disk: GiB of slack kept on the incomplete folder's drive after queued downloads, when it is not the library's drive. New torrents are refused below this. Set to 0 to disable.
add_subtitle: Search AniList and track an anime that is not in your lists.
add_no_results: No anime found for this search.
add_library_required: Configure the library before adding animes.
add_toast_tracked_no_episodes: Now tracking — no episode available yet
picker_hint: Pick the pack. The first is what the daemon would download.
picker_replace_confirm_msg: Every downloaded episode of {title} is deleted with its files (files handed to Shoko stay), then this torrent downloads in their place.

match.count=1: {count} pack · single episodes stay off this screen
match.count=*: {count} packs · single episodes stay off this screen

picker_nyaa_error: Nyaa is unavailable. Try another query.
picker_detail_error: Could not load the Nyaa page.
block_tracked: Already in one of your lists
block_library_not_configured: Configure the library before adding animes.
detail_delete_msg_standalone: It's removed from the app and no longer checked for new episodes.
detail_delete_msg_list: This anime comes from the list of {accounts}, so the app can't remove it: the list would bring it back. Take it off the list on AniList or MyAnimeList, or delete its files and blacklist it here.
detail_delete_msg_files_only: This anime is on no list and wasn't added by hand: it shows because its files are still here. Delete them to remove it, or blacklist it.
detail_delete_files_list: Delete downloaded files (they won't be downloaded again)
detail_delete_blacklist_hint: Stops checking and downloading it, and pauses its unfinished downloads. Its files stay unless you delete them.
detail_delete_done_removed_blacklisted: Removed from the app and blacklisted
detail_delete_done_blacklisted: Anime blacklisted: no more checks or downloads
detail_unblacklist_done: Taken off the blacklist: it's checked again from the next check

match.candidates=1: {candidates} torrent found, above the {limit} GiB ceiling.
match.candidates=*: {candidates} torrents found, all above the {limit} GiB ceiling.

match.candidates=1, seeders=1: {candidates} torrent found, without at least {seeders} seeder.
match.candidates=1, seeders=*: {candidates} torrent found, without at least {seeders} seeders.
match.candidates=*, seeders=1: {candidates} torrents found, none with at least {seeders} seeder.
match.candidates=*, seeders=*: {candidates} torrents found, none with at least {seeders} seeders.

lastcheck_disk_full: Not enough free space once queued downloads and the reserved disk floor are counted.

match.candidates=1: The torrent client rejected the only magnet.
match.candidates=*: The torrent client rejected all {candidates} magnets.

lastcheck_awaiting_earlier_episode: Not searched yet: an earlier episode is still missing.
lastcheck_max_episodes_per_anime: Per-anime limit reached: {downloaded} downloaded, {pending} still waiting.
lastcheck_batch_no_result: No batch torrent was found for this anime.
lastcheck_batch_above_size_limit: A batch was found but it is above the batch size ceiling.
lastcheck_batch_no_coverage: The batches found do not cover the pending episodes.
detail_lastcheck_notice: The last verification could not download episodes of this anime.
detail_lastcheck_episode_note: not downloaded in the last check
onboarding_step_source_hint: Your whole AniList or MyAnimeList list, or one anime at a time.
onboarding_step_check_hint: Every {minutes} min the daemon downloads what's missing. Nothing else to do.
onboarding_restore_hint: The intro card on the Status screen.
banner_backend_unreachable: No connection to the daemon. Check that it is running — this screen will not update until it is back.
banner_backend_error: The daemon responded with an error. This is an app bug; the data on screen may be incomplete.
banner_anilist_outage: AniList is down right now — nothing on your end. Your list may look out of date until it's back; the daemon will resume downloading on its own.
banner_anilist_rate_limited: AniList rate limit reached. Back to normal in {seconds}s.
banner_anilist_rate_limited_no_eta: AniList rate limit reached. Back to normal in about a minute.
banner_anilist_app_bug: The app is sending a query AniList no longer accepts. Update the app; if you are already on the latest version, please report it.
banner_serving_cache: Showing the local cache from {date}. You can still browse and manage episodes; anything newer than that is not here yet.
passerror_anilist: The last check did not run because AniList did not respond. It retries on its own next cycle.
passerror_mal: The last check did not run because MyAnimeList did not respond, or the list is private or empty. It retries on its own next cycle.
passerror_setup: The last check did not run because the library folder is not configured yet.
passerror_library: The last check did not run because the library folder does not support hardlinks. Pick a folder on a filesystem that supports them, or turn on Write Downloads Straight to the Library.
passerror_library_unwritable: The last check did not run because the library folder cannot be written to. Check that its drive is mounted and the app has permission.
passerror_incomplete_folder: The last check did not run because the incomplete downloads folder is missing or cannot be written to. Check that its drive is mounted; downloads waiting for it start again on their own.
passerror_torrent_backend: The last check did not run because the torrent client failed to start. Restart the app.
passerror_config: The last check did not run because the configuration could not be read.
passerror_storage: The last check did not run because the app's data could not be read.
passerror_unknown: The last check did not finish.
files_toggle: Show or hide the files of {name}
report_crash_toast: The app stopped unexpectedly and restarted
report_subtitle: Builds a report file on this machine. Nothing is sent until you attach it yourself.
report_what_happened_placeholder: What did you do, what did you expect, and what happened instead?
report_titles_label: Include anime titles and torrent names
report_titles_hint: Titles are needed to debug almost any search problem, and they also show what you download.
report_public_notice: Attachments on GitHub issues are public and permanent. Read the preview before attaching the file.
report_after_open: Now drag the downloaded file ({file}) into the issue.
priorities_subtitle: Controls the preference order used to rank and filter Nyaa releases.
priorities_note_criteria_order: Audio applies only to movies. Source applies to movies and to series whose AniList media status is FINISHED.
priorities_note_codecs: H.264 plays directly in any player; HEVC/AV1 take less space but get transcoded in the browser, which desyncs the subtitles.
priorities_item_custom: {item} — added by you, remove it with ✕
priorities_preset_compat_desc: H.264 first. Plays directly in any player, with no transcode on the server — subtitles stay soft. Bigger files.
priorities_preset_space_desc: AV1/HEVC first. Up to half the size at the same quality, but needs a player that decodes them — in the browser it becomes a transcode.
unsaved_changes_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?
config_hint_shoko_enabled: Episodes already in your Shoko library are never searched for or downloaded one by one, and the anime page shows them as In Shoko; a pack picked for other episodes can still bring them (see Download Full Megapacks). The app never deletes Shoko's files.
config_hint_shoko_url: Where Shoko Server answers, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8111.
config_hint_shoko_password: Sent to Shoko once to sign in: the app keeps only the key Shoko gives it, never the password.
config_shoko_never_synced: Not synced yet: the next check pass reads Shoko.
config_shoko_last_sync: Last sync {when}: {series} series, {episodes} episodes of the anime you follow.
config_hint_shoko_refresh: The first sync reads everything; later ones only what Shoko imported since.
config_label_shoko_watch: Follow Shoko's Changes as They Happen
config_hint_shoko_watch: Listens to Shoko: a file added to an episode or deleted there shows up here within seconds, instead of at the next refresh. After a lost connection the app reads your anime's series again, which catches what changed meanwhile. A file unlinked from an episode is the one change Shoko doesn't announce: use Full resync for it. A deleted episode is downloaded at the next check.
config_shoko_not_watching: Not connected to Shoko's changes yet; retrying. {error}
config_hint_shoko_full_sync: Reads all of Shoko again, so files deleted or moved there stop counting.
config_label_shoko_full_resync: Read All of Shoko Again Every
config_hint_shoko_full_resync: A full resync on its own, so a file unlinked from an episode in Shoko (the one change Shoko doesn't announce) stops counting. 0 = only when you press Full resync.
config_val_shoko_full_resync: Shoko's full resync must be 0 (never) or more days
config_hint_shoko_full_packs: A pack picked for one of your missing episodes downloads whole, so it also brings the episodes you already have in Shoko. On, the app keeps all of them as its own downloads: they show as downloaded on the anime page and follow the usual rules. Off, it removes those: with qBittorrent they're never downloaded; otherwise they're deleted once the pack finishes, and the pack stops seeding. Each anime can choose for itself on its page.
config_shoko_no_import_folder: Shoko has no import folder yet.
config_shoko_import_folders: Shoko's import folders, as Shoko sees them:
config_hint_shoko_folders: Shoko imports what lands in its import folders. A download folder inside one of them is in Shoko: when a download there finishes, the app asks Shoko to import new files right away, and the torrent keeps seeding. The app never deletes a file it handed to Shoko. Other download folders stay outside Shoko. Add Shoko's folders under Library › Download Folders.
config_hint_shoko_path_map: When Shoko or this app runs in Docker or on another machine, the same folder has a different path on each side. List each folder as this app sees it and as Shoko sees it. Empty = the same paths.
config_root_shoko_after_save: Save to see whether it is in Shoko
config_shoko_add_from: Add one of Shoko's import folders:
config_val_shoko_folder_in_place: A download folder in Shoko needs .part names or an Incomplete Downloads Folder, so Shoko never sees a half-written file
config_val_shoko_folder_qbit_staging: With qBittorrent, a download folder in Shoko can't use an Incomplete Downloads Folder: qBittorrent moves the files in under their final names, so Shoko could see a half-copied file
config_shoko_last_import: Last asked Shoko to import new files {when}.
config_shoko_import_error: Asking Shoko to import failed; the next check asks again: {error}
config_shoko_sync_started: Shoko sync started with a check pass.
config_val_shoko_refresh: Shoko's refresh must be at least 1 hour
config_label_use_qbittorrent: Use qBittorrent Instead of the Built-in Client
config_hint_use_qbittorrent: Drives your own qBittorrent 5.0 or later through its WebUI. It writes straight into the library, so it needs "Write Downloads Straight to the Library" on. The client is picked when the app starts: restart it after changing this.
config_hint_qbittorrent_url: Where qBittorrent's WebUI answers, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080.
config_hint_qbittorrent_password: Kept by the app and never shown again. Leave it as is to keep the saved one; type it again if you change the address.
config_hint_qbittorrent_api_key: Optional, needs a recent qBittorrent (Web API 2.14.1 or later): made in qBittorrent's WebUI settings. Used instead of the username and password.
config_hint_qbittorrent_category: Every torrent of the app gets this category. The app only touches torrents in it, so a qBittorrent you also use for other things is left alone.
config_label_qbittorrent_manage_settings: Let the App Manage This qBittorrent's Settings
config_hint_qbittorrent_manage_settings: Sets qBittorrent's download queue from Max Concurrent Downloads (in Downloads), with no cap on seeding. Leave it off if you also use this qBittorrent for other things: the app then changes nothing global in it, and qBittorrent's own queue applies.
config_hint_qbittorrent_path_map: Only when qBittorrent sees the library at another path than the app, e.g. in Docker or on another machine: the same folder as each side sees it.
config_path_map_app: Folder as the app sees it
config_path_map_qbittorrent: Same folder as qBittorrent sees it
config_qbittorrent_test_signin_key: Signed in with the API key.
config_qbittorrent_test_signin_password: Signed in with the username and password.
config_qbittorrent_test_disk_io: qBittorrent uses memory-mapped disk I/O. For a library on a USB or network disk, "Simple pread/pwrite" (its Advanced settings, then a restart of qBittorrent) is safer: a disk that goes away no longer crashes it. Letting the app manage its settings sets it for you.
config_qbittorrent_test_incomplete: It sees the incomplete folder at {path}.
config_qbittorrent_test_folder: It sees the download folder {name} at {path}.
config_qbittorrent_test_queue: Its download queue runs {count} at a time.
config_qbittorrent_test_queue_unlimited: Its download queue has no limit.
config_qbittorrent_test_queue_off: Its download queue is off: every download runs at once.
config_qbittorrent_needs_direct: Turn on "Write Downloads Straight to the Library" in Library first: qBittorrent writes there directly.
config_restart_required: Saved. Restart the app to switch the torrent client.
blacklist_intro: Anime here are not checked or downloaded, and their unfinished downloads are paused. Their files stay. Anime in an Excluded List on AniList are not listed here: that list is changed on AniList.
blacklist_empty: Nothing is blacklisted. To blacklist an anime, open it and use Delete.
add_unblacklist_msg: Adding it takes it off the blacklist: the app checks and downloads it again and resumes its paused downloads.
config_hint_rename_jellyfin_direct: Names each downloaded episode "Series - S02E05.mkv", inside its series and season folders. Packs and movies keep the names they came with.
config_hint_part_files_staged: No effect while an Incomplete Downloads Folder is set: unfinished files wait there instead.
config_hint_shoko_full_sync_off: Turn on Use Shoko and save first: while it's off, the app doesn't read Shoko.
config_shoko_sign_out_pending: Save to sign out of Shoko.
config_run_check_save_first: Save first: a check uses the saved settings.
config_hint_check_interval: Minutes between checks. Each check reads your lists and searches Nyaa for what's missing.
config_hint_retry_limit: How many magnet links an episode tries, best first, before it waits for the next check.
config_hint_delete_watched: Deletes the episodes you've watched, keeping the last ones set below, and the episodes of anime that left your lists. Downloads kept forever (direct mode with Delete Downloads Automatically off) are never deleted.
notifications_needs_event: Pick at least one event: with none, this webhook never fires.
